title: Where you're starting
learn: A short conversation so we can measure your starting point.

student.setup: First day of a seminar. The professor goes around the room.
student.opening: Welcome! Before we start, tell me a bit about yourself and why you took this class.

job_seeker.setup: The first minute of a job interview.
job_seeker.opening: Thanks for coming in. So, tell me about yourself.

customer_facing.setup: A customer walks up to you for the first time.
customer_facing.opening: Hi, I haven't been here before. Who are you, and can you help me?

creator.setup: You're a guest on a small podcast.
creator.opening: Welcome to the show! For listeners who don't know you yet, who are you and what do you make?

everyday.role: someone you just met at a party
everyday.setup: A friend's party. Someone new says hi.
everyday.opening: Hey! I don't think we've met. How do you know everyone here?

rubric.check: Says who they are or what they do early in their first answer
Gives at least one specific, concrete detail (a name, number, place or example) rather than only general claims
